title: ARKbar beach party and fire show
excerpt: Every night on Chaweng Beach: free fire show from 20:00 to about midnight, resident DJs from 22:00 and the beach party until 02:00. Free entry; family-friendly until 21:00, adults only after that.
content:
ARKbar on central Chaweng Beach runs the island's best-known nightly beach party. The fire show starts at 20:00 and runs on and off until about midnight, resident DJs play from 22:00, and the party peaks between midnight and 02:00, when it closes (later on special nights).

Entry is free; you pay for what you order. Children are welcome until 21:00, after that it is adults only. A beachfront sunbed for walk-ins has a minimum spend of about 300 THB.

Getting there: walk along the beach from anywhere in central Chaweng. Need a taxi back to your hotel or a table on a big night? Message us on WhatsApp.

title: ARKbar pool party
excerpt: Wednesday and Friday afternoons: DJs at the ARKbar pool from 14:00 to sunset, then the beach party and fire show from 20:00. Free entry.
content:
Twice a week ARKbar turns its pool into an afternoon party: DJs from 14:00 until about 19:00, then everyone moves to the beach for the nightly fire show at 20:00 and the beach party until 02:00.

Free entry; pool loungers and day beds go early, so arrive by 15:00 on busy weeks. Bring ID: the beach is adults only after 21:00.

title: Coco Tam's fire shows
excerpt: Nightly fire shows on the sand at Coco Tam's in Fisherman's Village, at about 19:15 and 21:30. Bean bags and swings on the beach; no entry fee.
content:
Coco Tam's, the beach bar with bean bags and swing seats on Bophut Beach in Fisherman's Village, puts on two fire shows every night: around 19:15 and 21:30. There is no entry fee, but beach seats fill up on Friday Walking Street nights, so arrive before 19:00.

The bar is open from midday to about 01:00. Combine it with dinner in Fisherman's Village or the Friday Walking Street.

title: Nikki Beach Amazing Sundays brunch
venue: Nikki Beach Koh Samui, Lipa Noi
excerpt: Sunday brunch party at Nikki Beach on the west coast, 12:00–16:30, with DJ and sunset afterwards. Book ahead; about 40 minutes from Chaweng.
content:
Nikki Beach's Amazing Sundays brunch runs from 12:00 to 16:30 at the beach club on Lipa Noi, on Koh Samui's quiet west coast. Expect a long buffet, a DJ and a dressed-up crowd; many people stay on for the sunset over the Five Islands.

Book a table in advance. Lipa Noi is about 40 minutes by car from Chaweng: we can arrange a private driver for the return trip on WhatsApp.
